snippet.title: Animal Life: North America Longplay [NDS] [No-Com]
snippet.description:
Educational game about animals living in North America
Minigames aren't necessary but you have to do all animals' minigames on Perfect to beat the game
Have Fun :D

00:00 Beginning
00:15 Husky
02:50 Puma
05:07 Animal Race
06:16 Rattlesnake
08:20 Coyote 
10:12 Munch
11:22 Grizzly Bear 
13:20 Ending + Credits
